description: Source code for configuring and generating low-level physical layer configurations for a 3GPP-compliant radio system, including functions to generate and fill configurations for DU low components, with detailed handling of PHY parameters, resource blocks, and PRACH settings.

methods.name: generate_du_low_config
methods.description: Generates a low-level DU configuration based on unit configuration and cell configurations, setting PHY parameters, resource allocations, and processing pipeline depths.

methods.name: generate_o_du_low_config
methods.description: Wrapper function to generate and assign the DU low configuration.

methods.name: fill_du_low_worker_manager_config
methods.description: Fills worker manager configuration for DU low, including concurrency limits and hardware acceleration overrides.
